scripts.build:dev: npm run build:assets && npm run build:ohif:dev && npm run copy:all && cd interface && npm run build:app
scripts.build:ohif:dev: cd ohif && cross-env PUBLIC_URL=/ohif/ yarn run build && cd .. && node scripts/convert.js ohif && npm run copy:ohif
scripts.build:ohif:prod: cross-env NODE_ENV=production APP_CONFIG=config/nextcloud.js PUBLIC_URL=/ohif/ NX_SKIP_NX_CACHE=true yarn run build
scripts.start: npm run copy:workers && cd interface && npm run dev
